The even-division differing-amount case (100+300 -> 200) fabricates a figure with no caveat, and the invariant claim was itself a docs-accuracy violation.

records.reason: Scope is copied first, then the reserved keys (outcome, flow) are set AFTER, so Scope cannot override them. TestRealizedLegScopeDoesNotOverrideOutcome (Scope outcome:success still yields the failed 500) pins it.
